strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed. 2. Victory conditions not met within 9 turns.
1. All allies destroyed
The colony laser... I never thought we'd be using it again.
Come to think of it, it got used in the last war too, right...?
Operation Maelstrom... right?
Back then we used it against the Titans, but...
Hasn't it been a while, though? Does it even still work?
It was under Federation control until recently.
With the arms reductions and this war, it's been left neglected, but...
from the look of it, it should be fine.
Honestly, I think it needs some emergency repairs.
...But from the look of it, it should manage at least this one shot.
Taking a place people lived in and turning it into a giant laser cannon.
Humans are frightening creatures.
Yes... maybe you're right.
But without it, we couldn't hope to snipe that giant planet...
No matter how powerful the Phase Transition Cannon is,
it can't match the power of a colony laser...
Something this big turned into a beam cannon?
It'll blow away an asteroid or two, easy as pie!
Hm...? What's wrong, Sara?
Sara? ...You imagined that. Shapiro's dead.
A dead guy can't do a damn thing.
...Shapiro...
...No, perhaps even the dead can pull at the living.
Huh? What do you mean, Captain?
...Even the dead can manage
to keep the ones who survived tied down...
Izumi... What's gotten into you?
...You mean like ghosts?
That's unscientific.
Take this a little more seriously.
Captain Bright, it won't fire just because we stare at it, right?
Right. All right, all units, launch! Time is... ten minutes.
If we finish investigating inside Gryps within ten minutes,
that should be enough, even allowing time to prep it for firing.
In that case, let's hurry.
There's no way the enemy's hiding all the way out here.
Let's get this over with.
I doubt we'll run into the enemy here... Let's just finish this quickly.
We have to secure this place, no matter what.
What's that!?
Tch! They were lying in wait for us... Hey, wait!
Multiple mechs inside Gryps II! They're not Federation!
Shinobu! That robot... it's from the plant planet...!
It seems they got here ahead of us.
Looks like they caught on to our moves, dammit!
More than that... that one bothers me.
Shinobu, about Shapiro being on that plant planet...
Sara might not have been wrong after all.
There's another mech we've never seen before!
Huh...!? Is that...!
What? You know that thing, Cyber Beast Force?
Explain. That's a type we've never seen either...
...It's what we fought in the Muge universe in the last war...!
What!?
...Muge Zorbados...
Then Emperor Muge is behind that plant planet!?
But, but~ didn't the Cyber Beast Force take that guy out?
Yeah, I finished him off with the Danku Sword...!
Hmph, the plant planet guys probably salvaged it and are using it!
That's true... It seems new forces using
the mechs of old ones happens a lot...
...No, that's not it... Shapiro brought them in!
Just like how he betrayed Earth... and went over to Muge!
Calm down, Sara.
Anyway, if we can't fire the colony laser, we're stuck!
Calm down. Even if that's true, we have something to do first!
Exactly. We only have... nine minutes left!
Eliminate all enemies inside Gryps II, and prep the colony laser to fire!
Commence attack!
(Shapiro... Is it really you...!?)
What!? Inside Gryps II!?
Multiple mechs inside Gryps II! They're not Federation!
Hm, those are... from that eerie asteroid...!
It seems they got here ahead of us. And look at this devastation...!
At this rate...
Yes, they got us...!
Hm!? Is that... Shapiro's mech!?
...It's you... Shapiro... It really is!
There's another mech we've never seen before!
Huh...!? Is that...!
What? You know that thing, Cyber Beast Force?
Explain. That's a type we've never seen either...
...It's what we fought in the Muge universe in the last war...!
What!?
...Muge Zorbados...
Then Emperor Muge is behind that plant planet!?
But, but~ didn't the Cyber Beast Force take that guy out?
Yeah, I finished him off with the Danku Sword...!
Hmph, the plant planet guys probably salvaged it and are using it!
...It seems new forces using
the mechs of old ones happens a lot...
...No, that's not it... Shapiro brought them in!
Just like how he betrayed Earth... and went over to Muge!
Calm down, Sara.
Anyway, if we can't fire the colony laser, we're stuck!
Calm down. Even if that's true, we have something to do first!
(Shapiro... Is it really you...!?)
...Sara...
Hey, that voice just now!
Seriously!? Gimme a break!
What's wrong!? A transmission from the enemy!?
...I can more or less guess. Though I'd rather be wrong...
Which means, sure enough...
Fujiwara, that voice... surely not...
...Sara...
Like I'd ever forget that voice! Shapirooooo!
It can't be...!
The worst traitor in history... What's he doing here!?
Gimme a break. Now we have to fight other Earthlings again!?
Shapiro! It's me! It's Sara!
Stop it, Sara!
...Sara...
Get a grip, Sara! Even if Shapiro's alive... he's the enemy!
Sara, get a grip!
Here they come! We're out of time!
With the colony laser unable to fire, if this takes too long here,
we won't make it to the plant planet in time! Hurry!
...Let's do this, Shinobu...!
Sara, you... are you okay?
...I'll cut him off... as many times as it takes...
...Sara...
Well, well... Just as he said... the Earthlings
really did come to make use of this facility.
What!? Enemy reinforcements!?
There's still more!? Gimme a break!
They never end! And we're almost out of time!
It's galling to dance to Shapiro's tune...
but if it's Lady Diore's command, it can't be helped...
Right, commence attack! Slaughter every one of these lowly Earthlings!
Here they come...! We're short on time. We'll go on the offensive!
All right! Let's wrap this up fast!
But how did they know we'd be here!?
...I don't get it. Any way you look at it, they're a step ahead... A leak?
Is it really this Shapiro guy?
It's just a coincidence, Sara.
Quit yapping! We just smash 'em all together!
Let's do it!
Lord Shapiro...!
...Keim, is it?
What!? Enemy reinforcements!?
As you said, Lord Shapiro... The Earthlings really came for this!
There's still more!? Gimme a break!
They never end! And we're almost out of time!
You fell right into Lord Shapiro's trap, foolish Earthlings...!
This shattered glass tube shall be your tombstone...!
Here they come...! We're short on time. We'll go on the offensive!
All right! Let's wrap this up fast!
Shapiro Keats! So you really have sunk to being an alien invader...!
...I'm sure he has his own reasons... but we can't let him do this.
Who cares about his reasons! Let's go!
Sara?
Leave her be, Masato! ...Sara, let's do this!
Hm!? More of them!?
There were still more hiding...!?
Hey, hey, you mean they saw right through everything we did!?
Huh!? Then... isn't that bad!?
What's going on!? They got ahead of us way too smoothly...!
You're right, Tetsuya. They've completely beaten us to the punch...!
...Sara...
Hey, that voice just now!
Seriously!? Gimme a break!
What's wrong!? A transmission from the enemy!?
Megumi, what was that just now?
It came from the mech that just appeared!
...I can more or less guess. Though I'd rather be wrong...
Which means, sure enough...
Fujiwara, that voice... surely not...
Sara...
Like I'd ever forget that voice! Shapirooooo!
It can't be...!
The worst traitor in history... What's he doing here!?
Gimme a break. Now we have to fight other Earthlings again!?
Shapiro! It's me! It's Sara!
Stop it, Sara!
...Sara...
Get a grip, Sara! Even if Shapiro's alive... he's the enemy!
Sara, get a grip!
Here they come! We're out of time!
Any more delay and the plant planet will drift out of
the colony laser's line of fire! Hurry!
...Let's do this, Shinobu...!
Sara, you... are you okay?
...I'll cut him off... as many times as it takes...
...Sara...
Nngh... To take... this much damage...
Go back, Shapiro! There's no place for you in this world anymore!
He retreated.
It appears he has escaped Gryps II.
Seems like... there's some kind of story there.
...Shapiro... you idiot...
Well, don't let it get you down. That was...
Koji!
Hm, what is it, Maria? I'm just trying to cheer her up...
Idiot! At times like this, you keep quiet!
So the traitor's returned.
Tetsuya!
You insensitive jerk! At times like this, you don't say anything!
Sara.
Sorry, Shinobu.
You too, Maria. I'm... all right.
We made it! All right, check the interior, then target the plant planet!
Let's blast it with a big boom!
No, the inspection will still take a little time...
I just hope the battle didn't cause any damage...
...My bad feeling was right.
The laser emitter's output isn't rising.
So it did take damage.
Unbelievable...! All for nothing!?
And here I thought we'd finally be rid of that creepy asteroid!
Muge Empire mechs... That bugs me. What's going on...?
This is no time to brood. Let's get out of here.
Right. The Ra Cailum and the Nadesico will leave this airspace
and head for the next point!
...Shapiro... I won't hesitate anymore...
All cleared out? ...Good, we're pulling out of Gryps II immediately!
We can't use it... anymore, can we? Not like this...
Yes, not in this state.
The damage is very recent.
Meaning...
In short, it was wrecked right before we arrived.
It seems they read our moves...
Unbelievable...! All for nothing!?
And here I thought we'd finally be rid of that creepy asteroid!
Shapiro... I never thought he'd appear before us again.
And since he was waiting for us at Gryps... it's as Dr. Inez said:
they completely read our moves...
Shapiro Keats... I guess we'll have to settle for knowing what he's up to.
In that case, let's leave here at once. There's no time.
Right. The Ra Cailum and the Nadesico will leave this airspace
and head for the next point!
...Shapiro... I won't hesitate anymore...
